interpretation.quality: Filtered lower-resolution light buffer trades detail for softer highlights. Gallery uses64 cells vs default40. No all-device or pixel-identical speedup claim.
interpretation.comparison: Expanded vs indexed static UV inputs yield different derivative/focal-line pixel values despite matching source geometry, optics, topology and buffer size; timings are reported as experiments, not an exact-render speedup.
interpretation.previous: Three earlier complete experiment reports retained. The final waves are broader and wallpaper filters the caustic map in five taps, without another pass.
